digest.component_or_area: rebar-janitor codebase-health audit and maintenance workflow
propositions: Comprehensive janitor audit completed across 113 raw findings consolidated to 47 verified survivors (29 critical, 18 major), with 37 remediation items approved/refined for 24 Janitor Cleanup child tickets pending final verification of durable artifact evidence.

Critical architectural removals and compatibility migrations approved: scheduled deprecations (transition force_close, hosted-OpenAI Chat), internal shims, reconcile CLI family, and reviewer-selection inputs, with atomic caller migration and prerequisite ADR governance required before implementation.

Deferred high-complexity decisions: namespace relocation (RP11 awaits financial-stoneware-brant terminal state), OpenAI Chat-to-Responses wire binding (RP12), cross-facade lifecycle unification (RP08), close-workflow operation authority (RP04/ADR 0098 vs 0005), and future semantic documentation governance (RP32), each with recovery triggers and evidence retention.

Eight supplemental dead-code removals require split-scope or pre-migration: reconciler RescheduleError deferred to compatibility removal, pass4_coach/guard_passes deferred to workflow oracle migration, three shim renames require six-caller atomicity, and Jira adapters require ownership correction before deletion.

Audit discovery/verification phase confirmed 78 deduplicated candidates with independent blue-team blue-teaming, citing exact path:line references, establishing reachability harm, and checking prior decisions and known-fine registry; fixed validity/impact floors (0.75/0.5) produced 47 survivors with 31 explicit non-survivors documented.
